description.value:
Your mines push or pull creatures away from them. You gain the following new mods.

  • Big Bang (mine exocortex): Your mines blow enemies away. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the mine are pushed 5 feet directly away from the mine (or pushed 10 feet directly away from the mine and knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone] on a critical failure). This is forced movement.

  • Black Hole (mine exocortex): Your mines harness gravity-bending technology. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the mine are pulled 5 feet toward the mine (or pulled 10 feet toward the mine and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} on a critical failure). This is forced movement.
